items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Big Iloy was living at that corner... We was right there in the neighborhood. Half a block and a block apart.

ctx.x: Why did he change, you think, August?

Well, you see, they wasn't using very much C's around here. They wasn't using very much C's. The only clarinet they were using around here was the B flat. Now, some fellows used to carry A flat for transposition. But they just used to use the B flat and do the same transposition on that B flat. Well, I guess Big I must have- You see, it was much easier for transposition if you had- Some fellows used to carry three, four clarinets. The A, the B, the D, and what's the other one, the E scale?
The little short one is the E flat.
